name: Simon the Leper
title: Dinner Host
description: Once known only by his disease, Simon was healed by Jesus and now hosts a dinner in his own home. His table becomes the setting for one of the most significant acts of worship in the Gospel narrative — Mary's anointing of Jesus with expensive perfume.

attitude.neutral: Grateful, humble, and somewhat bemused by the attention his table receives.
attitude.positive: Proud to host Jesus and the disciples, moved by the devotion shown at his dinner.
attitude.negative: Defensive of his household and the memory of the night, aware that some still judge him by his past.

background: Simon the Leper was likely healed by Jesus at some point before this dinner. His willingness to host Jesus publicly, despite his past condition, shows the transformative power of his encounter with Christ. The dinner at his house becomes a stage for both extravagant worship and hidden betrayal.
